summary: Americold Realty Trust filed an 8-K reporting a fourth amendment to its existing credit agreement. The amendment extends the maturity date of a $250 million delayed draw term facility from June 19, 2026 to September 19, 2026. No new borrowing is reported, and the extension is purely administrative in nature. The filing does not involve any change of control, acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or other special-situation event. It is a routine financing arrangement update.
